messages.subject: A Question on simsem
parts:
Hi all,

May I ask a question about simsem? I tried the following syntax but it does not work. I wonder if anyone can illuminate me about the problem of the syntax?

Thank you in advance!

Chester

#############################

popModel <- "
f1 =~ 0.8*y11 + 0.75*y12 + 0.65*y13 + 0.6*y14 + (-0.8)*y15 + (-0.75)*y16 + (-0.65)*y17 + (-0.6)*y18 
f2 =~ 0.8*y21 + 0.75*y22 + 0.65*y23 + 0.6*y24 + 0.8*y25 + 0.75*y26 + 0.65*y27 + 0.6*y28

f3 =~ 0.3*y11 + 0.3*y12 + 0.3*y13 + 0.3*y14 + 0.3*y15 + 0.3*y16 + 0.3*y17 + 0.3*y18
f3 =~ 0.3*y21 + 0.3*y22 + 0.3*y23 + 0.3*y24 + 0.3*y25 + 0.3*y26 + 0.3*y27 + 0.3*y28 

f1 ~~ 0.5*f2 + 0*f3
f2 ~~ 0*f3

f1 ~~ 1*f1
f2 ~~ 1*f2
f3 ~~ 1*f3

y1 ~~ 0.27*y1
y2 ~~ 0.3475*y2
y3 ~~ 0.4875*y3
y4 ~~ 0.55*y4
y5 ~~ 0.27*y5
y6 ~~ 0.3475*y6
y7 ~~ 0.4875*y7
y8 ~~ 0.55*y8
"

analyzeModel <- "
f1 =~ NA*y11 + y12 + y13 + y14 + y15 + y16 + y17 + y18
f2 =~ NA*y21 + y22 + y23 + y24 + y25 + y26 + y27 + y28

f1 ~~ f2 

f1 ~~ 1*f1
f2 ~~ 1*f2

y11 ~~ y11
y12 ~~ y12
y13 ~~ y13
y14 ~~ y14
y15 ~~ y15
y16 ~~ y16
y17 ~~ y17
y18 ~~ y18

y21 ~~ y21
y22 ~~ y22
y23 ~~ y23
y24 ~~ y24
y25 ~~ y25
y26 ~~ y26
y27 ~~ y27
y28 ~~ y28
"

Output <- sim(100, analyzeModel, n=1000, generate=popModel, std.lv=TRUE, lavaanfun = "cfa")

Progress: 1 / 100 
Error in names(coef) <- lab : 
  'names' attribute [35] must be the same length as the vector [33]

messages.author: bfa43814f6ba1969
messages.subject: Re: A Question on simsem (This is a simsem bug)
parts:
Hi,

That looks like a bug in simsem. The workaround is to allow simsem to automatically add some parameters instead of specifying them manually.

analyzeModel <- "
f1 =~ y11 + y12 + y13 + y14 + y15 + y16 + y17 + y18
f2 =~ y21 + y22 + y23 + y24 + y25 + y26 + y27 + y28
"

If you want to see what the problem is, you can troubleshoot as follows. After the error message, do

Error in names(coef) <- lab : 
  'names' attribute [35] must be the same length as the vector [33]

> traceback()
4: runRep(simConds[[i]], ...)
3: FUN(X[[i]], …)
..

From this output, you can see that the line that caused the problem is "names(coef) <- lab” in function simsem:::runRep. Then you print out the function as a list

as.list(body(simsem:::runRep))

from which you can see that the line is included in the 50th step. Then you print that step 

as.list(as.list(body(simsem:::runRep))[[50]])

and note that the line is in the 3rd step inside that step. Doing recursively, you end up with 

as.list(as.list(as.list(as.list(as.list(as.list(as.list(as.list(body(simsem:::runRep))[[50]])[[3]])[[3]])[[3]])[[2]])[[4]])[[4]])

and note that the line is the 19th step in that.

Then you set up tracing:

trace(simsem:::runRep,browser, at = list(c(50,3,3,3,2,4,4,19)))


Running the code after that allows you to inspect what R is doing right before the error. At least the following commands are useful for understanding why the label and coefficient length do not match

print(coef)
print(lab)
summary(fit)

After you are done, you can remove tracing by doing

untrace(simsem:::runRep)


The  bug is that the coefficients includes only free parameters whereas the labels includes both free parameters and parameters that were constrained by user. 

Mikko

I see. Thanks. In my example, can you illuminate me how I can add parameters automatically?
Just use

f1 =~ y11 + y12 + y13 + y14 + y15 + y16 + y17 + y18

f2 =~ y21 + y22 + y23 + y24 + y25 + y26 + y27 + y28”

The error variances and factor covariances are added automatically.

This problem occurs with the 0.5-13 version, which is the latest released version on CRAN. 

Mikko
